skill.name: chakra-ui-builder
skill.description: Build responsive, accessible UI components and layouts using Chakra UI v3, install or configure Chakra UI in new and existing projects, and design scalable themes using tokens, semantic tokens, recipes, and slot recipes. Use this skill whenever a user asks to build, create, or generate any UI component, page, form, dashboard, navbar, card, landing section, pricing table, or layout using Chakra UI; wants to add Chakra UI to a project, set up ChakraProvider, run CLI snippets, configure color mode, or fix provider wrapping; or asks about theming — defining brand colors, design tokens, semantic tokens, dark mode values, component recipes, slot recipes, typegen, or ejecting the default theme. Trigger on any Chakra UI building, setup, or theming or charts request, however casually phrased — "add my brand colors", "make a reusable card style", "build a bar chart", "show me a line chart", "make me a login form", "build a sidebar", "add Chakra to my app".
skill.summary: Build Chakra UI v3 interfaces with responsive layouts, accessible components, custom themes, and charts.

content.user_title: Build Chakra UI Components, Themes, and Charts
content.value_statement: Chakra UI projects need consistent setup, responsive layouts, and reusable styling. This skill guides component selection, provider configuration, theming, and chart composition using Chakra UI v3 patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guide Chakra UI installation, CLI snippet generation, provider setup, and color mode configuration for React projects.
Compose responsive layouts using Stack, Flex, Grid, SimpleGrid, and mobile-first breakpoint props.
Apply form labeling, error text, semantic markup, and accessible names when generating interface components.
Define custom tokens, dark mode semantic tokens, recipes, and slot recipes using Chakra UI v3 APIs.
Explain type generation and default theme ejection through the Chakra CLI.
Compose BarList, BarSegment, and Recharts visualizations with token-aware colors, tooltips, and legends.
limitations: This package contains instructions and reference examples, not a standalone application or executable UI generator.
Guidance targets Chakra UI v3; projects using other versions require compatibility checks.
Installation and CLI workflows require suitable tooling and can download dependencies or write project files.
Generated code and reference examples still require dependency checks, compilation, browser testing, and accessibility validation.

use_cases.title: Configure a React application
use_cases.description: Set up Chakra UI, generated snippets, provider wrapping, and color mode while matching the existing framework and package manager.

use_cases.title: Standardize a component library
use_cases.description: Define brand tokens, light and dark semantic colors, and reusable recipes for consistent component styling.

use_cases.title: Build an analytics view
use_cases.description: Compose responsive dashboard layouts and charts with formatted values, tooltips, legends, and theme-aware colors.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Create a responsive form
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Chakra UI v3 contact form with name, email, and message fields. Include labels, error states, and mobile-first spacing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a small interface using standard Chakra components.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Configure project setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Next.js App Router dependencies and provider files. Configure Chakra UI v3 and color mode. Explain required commands before running them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Integrate Chakra UI into an existing application.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Design reusable theme styles
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend our existing Chakra UI v3 theme with brand colors #2563eb and #16a34a. Add dark mode semantic tokens, reusable recipes, and typegen guidance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expand a shared design system without replacing existing configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Compose a dashboard chart
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a responsive monthly revenue and expenses chart using Chakra UI charts and Recharts. Include tooltips, legends, currency formatting, and dark mode colors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a multi-series visualization within an application dashboard.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive account settings form with Chakra UI v3.
output: A form component with labeled inputs, helper text, and visible error states.
A mobile-first layout that expands at the desktop breakpoint.
A brief explanation of component choices and accessibility considerations.

output_examples.input: Add brand colors and reusable card variants to our existing Chakra theme.
output: A theme extension with brand tokens and separate light and dark semantic values.
A coordinated card slot recipe with reusable variants.
Provider integration guidance, usage examples, and a type generation reminder.

output_examples.input: Show monthly revenue and expenses in a dashboard chart.
output: A chart component with monthly data and separate revenue and expense series.
Theme-aware series colors, a legend, tooltips, and formatted values.
Dependency guidance for Chakra UI charts and Recharts.

best_practices: Check the installed Chakra version, framework, package manager, and existing components before generating changes.
Prefer semantic tokens and appropriate Chakra primitives; test responsive behavior, keyboard navigation, and both color modes.
Review installation commands and generated files, then compile the project and regenerate types after theme changes.
anti_patterns: Mixing Chakra UI v2 and v3 APIs without checking the installed version.
Replacing suitable Chakra components with deeply nested Box elements or inaccessible custom controls.
Treating generated examples as production-verified code without compilation, interaction checks, and accessibility testing.

faq.question: Which Chakra UI version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It defaults to Chakra UI v3 patterns. It recommends v2 patterns only when the project explicitly uses v2.

faq.question: Can it help add Chakra UI to an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers dependency installation, CLI snippets, provider wrapping, color mode setup, and common setup issues.

faq.question: Does it cover custom themes and dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. Its theming reference covers tokens, semantic colors, recipes, slot recipes, provider integration, type generation, and theme ejection.

faq.question: Can it build charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers BarList, BarSegment, and Recharts composition through Chakra UI charts, including themed colors, tooltips, and legends.

faq.question: Does using the skill require network access?
faq.answer: Reading the bundled guidance does not require network access. Dependency installation and CLI package retrieval generally require registry access.

faq.question: Are generated interfaces guaranteed to compile and meet accessibility requirements?
faq.answer: No. The guidance includes accessibility practices, but generated code and reference examples still need compilation, browser testing, and accessibility validation.
